The full cover graph is isomorphic, so every parent fractional dual certificate transports with identical pair loads.

No child edge with an even coordinate can support a relevant semi-filter because the corresponding generator trace is empty; all relevant child cover objects are copies of parent objects. Therefore integral and fractional cover optima are exactly unchanged.
The exact one-step increment is zero, so this rule cannot yield a positive divergent lower-bound recurrence. This is not an upper bound on the optimum under other rules.
The selected copy-only rule has no growth, but no upper bound is proved for the parent atom's unrestricted rule universe.

difference_witness.shared_coordinate: transport old fractional-dual support across a graph-complement extension
difference_witness.difference: C037 changes the same-scale complement so one of three positive parent supports loses relevance. C041A embeds the complete old complement as an isolated odd-odd slice, so relevance and old dual feasibility are exact, yet no genuinely new relevant child semi-filter exists and augmentation is exactly zero.
difference_witness.consequence: PERSISTENCE and AUGMENTATION are independent obligations; success on the former cannot be used as evidence for the latter.

residual_slack_criterion.statement: For lifted old dual y with pair load ell(p)<=1, a fresh mass epsilon>0 on one new relevant semi-filter K is feasible iff every pair p covering K satisfies ell(p)<1.
residual_slack_criterion.next_falsifier: Any future extension rule must exhibit an off-slice relevant semi-filter K outside the coverage neighborhoods of all saturated lifted pairs; one saturated covering pair kills one-coordinate augmentation immediately.
